explanation: Dory is a blue tang. Real clownfish shelter among the stinging tentacles of sea anemones, protected by a coat of mucus.

claims.text: In Finding Nemo (2003), Nemo is a clownfish.
Nemo is not a blue tang, an angelfish or a pufferfish; in the film Dory is a blue tang and Bloat is a pufferfish.
Dory, in Finding Nemo, is a blue tang.
Clownfish live among the stinging tentacles of sea anemones, protected by a coat of mucus.
